name: review-check-stale-cache
title: sd-review gates on a memoized check that reads live inputs
description: The review coordinator computes the typed sd-check once per attempt and gates every later run at the same head on the memoized report. Two of those checks read live inputs the state identity does not capture: knowledge.obsidian-kb reads the gitignored .obsidian-kb symlink target, and pack.review-scope reads the live PR body. worktreeDigest excludes gitignored paths and is None for PR scope, and only prNumber is in identity, so once a stale computation is cached at a head every later run there serves it -- false-blocking the post-finalization successor-head review after the KB is refreshed or the PR body fixed. A consumer repository already carries a local fix that this pack reverts on every refresh.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Found from a consumer (platypeeps/se-ai-command-pack) on 2026-08-07, same route as the three defects filed in 6f810484 from auditing hoa-manager. That consumer already carries the reference fix as a local fork of an install: "always" file -- bc01bc2 extracts _resolve_check and ships 5 guard tests -- so this pack reverts the fix on every refresh of it. _resolve_check exists in no version here (checked all 33 v0.6* tags across 1975 commits). Confirmed 2026-08-07: refreshing that consumer 0.64.3 -> 0.64.27 removed the fix and errored all 5 tests, so the refresh was reverted and the consumer is pinned 24 versions behind by this defect. Read bc01bc2 before designing a different remedy. Consumer-side record is tracked there as 08-07-review-py-local-fork.
